Sanfreight Real Estate

Spaces made for you.
We design living spaces tailored to your current and future needs.

For us, real estate is not just a financial investment; it's a means to create unique and inspiring living spaces that meet the needs and expectations of our clients.

We harness the full potential of our projects through our expertise in real estate revitalization. We are passionate about transforming old buildings or undervalued sites into outstanding real estate projects.

We develop projects tailored to today's and tomorrow's lifestyles.

We design contemporary and sustainable buildings.

To make each new space a unique and inspiring place to live.

Our expertises

Realize your projects alongside us

01

The promise of a high architectural quality.

We strive to develop living spaces where it is pleasant to live.

We adapt our spaces to current and future trends, making them unique and outstanding.

  • Constant monitoring of design and architecture trends to stay at the forefront of innovation.
  • Partnerships with renowned architects to ensure a global and contemporary vision.
  • Rigorous selection of durable, aesthetic, and high-quality materials to guarantee both functionality and beauty.
02

A stylish and functional interior.

Beyond facades and structures, the very essence of a space lies in its interior design.

Interior architecture is not just an afterthought: it is at the heart of every project, ensuring that each space not only visually appeals, but also meets your functional needs.

  • Integration of design from the start of the process to ensure perfect harmony between interiors and exteriors.
  • Spaces adapted to the specific needs of clients, reflecting their personality and lifestyle.
  • Selection of durable materials without compromising on aesthetics, ensuring lasting beauty.
03

A carbon-neutral vision of construction

Integration of design from the start of the process to ensure perfect harmony between the interior and exterior.

Spaces adapted to the specific needs of clients, reflecting their personality and lifestyle.

Selection of durable materials without compromising on aesthetics, ensuring lasting beauty.

A carbon-neutral vision of construction

We challenge the traditional approach to construction with an eco-responsible approach, combining our expertise with innovation, be it in terms of materials, technologies, or methods.

  • Incorporation of ecological principles from the design phase, guaranteeing a significant reduction in our carbon footprint.
  • Adoption of the latest innovations in ecological construction, renewable energy systems, and durable materials.
  • artnerships with companies and startups committed to promoting environmentally friendly construction practices.
04

A frictionless real estate purchase

Buying property is a decisive step, often a source of concerns and questions.

We transform this often stressful journey into a motivating and reassuring experience. From the first contact to handing over the keys, we guide you every step of the way, ensuring a purchase with confidence.

  • Continuous access to the details, progress, and costs of your project, eliminating any surprises.
  • A single point of contact throughout your journey, ensuring smooth and reassuring communication.
  • Use of digital tools for a precise visualization of your future property, allowing you to concretely project yourself into your future home.
05

Diverse expertise in real estate

We can intervene in residential, office, hotel, or even logistics projects.

This multidisciplinarity allows us to perfectly adapt spaces by creating synergies between the different needs of users.

  • Grouping of experts specialized in each sector - residential, offices, hotels, logistics - to guarantee high-level expertise.
  • egular analyses of trends specific to each segment to anticipate the needs and expectations of users.
  • Exploration of best practices from each sector to transfer and adapt them to others, thus creating innovative synergies.

A modern customer journey

An immersive digital experience

Dive into the heart of your future home; it's possible. You have the opportunity to visit every nook and cranny of your property, but you can also shape it to your liking. Instantly visualize the changes, from wall colors to interior layouts, and craft your ideal space.

Our ESG strategy

Creating sustainable living spaces.
Our commitment
Active integration of ESG criteria
We are aware of the significant impact of real estate on the environment and the importance of social and governance issues in any meaningful and sustainable investment strategy. Therefore, we are committed to acting as a responsible investor and minimizing the effects of operating our real estate assets.

Sanfreight supports global sustainability and is committed to actively integrating Environmental, Social, and Governance dimensions into the management of its assets.
Our conviction
The links between performance and impact
At Sanfreight, we firmly believe that financial performance and environmental and social impact are inherently linked.

We are convinced that a responsible investment strategy is inseparable from significant value creation. In other words, for us, a company's performance cannot be considered independently of its footprint on the world.
Our promise
Sustainable performance
We believe that true value can only be created through sustainable performance. For us, this means investing responsibly, managing our assets with care, and honoring our commitments to our partners and shareholders.

By placing ESG criteria at the core of our approach, we aim to ensure the long-term financial performance of our investments and contribute to a better world for all. This is our promise at Sanfreight.
